newsitem.title: USA: ADESA expands auto auctions in Pennylvania.
newsitem.headline: ADESA expands auto auctions in Pennylvania.

text.p: ADESA Corp, a large vehicle auction company, said Wednesday it acquired Interstate Auto Auction in Mercer, Pa. further expanding its business in Pennsylvania.
ADESA, which is also a subsidiary of Minnesota Power & Light Co, said the acquisition increases to 25 the number of facilities it has in North America.
ADESA owns and operates auto auctions and provides related services, through which used cars and other vehicles are sold to franchised automobile dealers and licensed used car dealers.
Minnesota Power, based in Duluth, Minn., provides electric utility operations in Minnesota and Wisconsin, water utilities in Florida and the Carolinas.
Shares of Minnesota Power rose 1/4 to 28-/2.
